title: fix(sdk): use pipe delimiter for reference image array in query params
author: Saauf

gist.summary: The SDK now joins arrays passed as the `image` query parameter with `|` instead of `,`, matching the API’s reference-media format. This fixes video start/end keyframe references and image generation with multiple reference images, including URLs whose query parameters contain commas. Tests cover both cases.
